author: Offer Shina
description: A personal blog by Offer Shina about mitochondria and VDAC1 — the science, the news, and why a PSEN1 carrier can't stop reading about it.

hero.titleHtml: The powerhouse of the cell has a front door. I write about it.
hero.lead: Hi — I'm Offer. This is my personal, slightly obsessive blog about mitochondria and, especially, VDAC1: the little pore that runs the traffic on the mitochondrial surface and keeps turning up in disease. Real papers, plain language, zero corporate polish.
